rv.q: Marie and Rosetta is one of the best theatrical performances of the year
But George Brant's 'Marie and Rosetta' at Northlight Theatre offers both great music and a real story.

And while the timeframe of the work is a bit uneven, that hardly matters given the bravura performances of the two exceptionally talented Chicago actresses who so ideally capture the essence of a real-life collaboration that evolved many years ago.
The technical aspects of this production are just as amazing as the performances.

cn.t: Critics rave about this captivating production, with stellar performances and direction bringing the story of gospel pioneers Sister Rosetta Tharpe and Marie Knight to electrifying life through powerful music and emotionally resonant storytelling.
